steps.say: The bottoms are different, so you cannot add the tops yet. Rewrite both fractions over the smallest number that both denominators divide into: LCM([[a_den]], [[b_den]]) = [[lcm]].

$\frac{[[a_num]]}{[[a_den]]}$ is already over [[lcm]], and $\frac{[[b_num]]}{[[b_den]]}$ becomes $\frac{[[b_scaled]]}{[[lcm]]}$ — the fraction is still worth the same, just written with a bigger whole.
Now the bottoms match, so the tops can be added straight: [[a_scaled]] + [[b_scaled]] = [[raw_num]], out of [[raw_den]].

answer: In lowest terms that is $\frac{[[out_num]]}{[[out_den]]}$ — divide [[raw_num]] and [[raw_den]] by their common factor if they have one.
